name: stale_baselines
registered: 2026-11-10, before any run of these rows on a real scene (user, 2026-11-10: 'I need more baseline in table IV')
question: The stale-answer rate of Table IV (tab:stale) for more baselines: the update frame's own 2D features, Feature 3DGS and LEGaussians re-trained with the update frames, and a reset fired by baseline detectors.
metric: The N2 stale-answer rate of scripts/dump_nor_qual.py (contrast_and_fa), unchanged: the share of the covered masks_real pixels, over every update keyframe with a mask, whose top class (argmax over the 101 classes of configs/vocab_replica.json, LSeg templates, ties = no class) is the scene's query. Coverage: the map's rendered alpha >= tau_cov (the record's value), the same pixels for every row. The query is read from the scene's dump (results/qual/nor/<scene>/contrast.json) and never chosen again. Lower is better.

rows.2d: 2D features, per frame: the update keyframe's own LSeg features in the field's PCA basis (eval_change_nor.view_inputs: tokens -> bilinear upsample -> PCA-64 projection), no map. A reference row: it has no memory, so it is not ranked against the maps.
rows.f3dgs_upd: Feature 3DGS re-trained on the scene's mapping AND update keyframes (scripts/distill_update_nor.py); its per-Gaussian features rendered with the splat weights.
rows.legs_l1_upd: LEGaussians (lambda_u = 1, the value chosen on validation for Table III, configs/nor_distilled_prereg.json) re-trained on the mapping AND update keyframes; its 8-d codes rendered, then decoded by its MLP.
rows.reset_feat_depth: No new run: variant V1 of configs/reset_fused_prereg.json (registered 2026-10-23, test run once): the feature residual and the depth residual, rank-fused, fire our field's reset at their label-free threshold. Its per-scene stale-answer rate is read from results/reset_fused/test/<scene>.json.
rows.reset_normlift_depth: No new run: variant V3 of the same registration: NormLift's reliability drop and the depth residual, rank-fused, fire the reset. Read from the same records.
rows.f3dgs, legs_l1: Reference only (report, not the paper): the maps trained on the mapping keyframes alone and frozen (the Table III files), on the same pixels.

training.script: scripts/distill_update_nor.py (imports scripts/distill_features.py and usplat/distill.py, never edits them)
training.frames: the mapping keyframes and the update keyframes that scripts/eval_change_nor.py load_context reads for the scene's Table III record (results/nor/tab2_relmax/<split>/<scene>.json: its field, update stride, alignment and keyframe rule), so the trained maps see the frames our field has seen after its update
training.settings_source: scripts/distill_features.py defaults, as Table I and Table III

evaluation.script: scripts/stale_baselines_nor.py (imports scripts/dump_nor_qual.py, scripts/eval_change_nor.py and scripts/eval_change_nor_distilled.py, never edits them)
evaluation.outputs: results/stale_baselines/<split>/<scene>_<pass>.json, pass = light (2d and the frozen maps) or trained (the re-trained maps)

controls.before: Every run recomputes the row 'before' (the mapping field's mu*, rendered) and compares it with the scene's dump. Stop rule (exit 2): the rate differs by more than 0.5 points or the pixel count n_mask_cov differs by more than 0.5%.
controls.frozen: The frozen maps' rows are a second check of the trained-map path: with no update they must stay near their own level after mapping.

selection: None. No row has a free parameter here (lambda_u comes from the Table III registration). Validation only checks the pipeline: the light pass on the 4 validation scenes, the trained pass on validation scene 002.
test_policy: After the validation controls pass, each pass runs once on the 10 test scenes; a finished test record is never overwritten. Every row is reported, including scenes where a baseline is lower than ours. Nothing changes after the test run.
paper: Table IV gets the new rows next to 'after mapping', NormLift and ours. Bold = best and underline = second best per scene among the rows that keep a map; the 2D row and 'after mapping' are reference rows.
budget: about 5 GPU hours: 22 trainings (medians on these scenes: 1059 s Feature 3DGS, 583 s LEGaussians) and 28 short evaluations, through scripts/gpu_gate.sh
